==Descriptions==
'''Frozen Battlefront''',<ref>https://create.roblox.com/store/asset/15371239766/Frozen-Battlefront-Temp</ref> more commonly known by the community as '''Winterfall''', was the second [[map]] made for the [[Frost Invasion Event]]. However, it ended up getting scrapped, making [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)|Outpost 32]] become the event's map.

Like other event maps, it would have had a specialized wave structure with special [[enemies]], which from teasers posted before the update would have mostly been the same as enemies seen in [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)|Outpost 32]].

==Design & Path==
'''Frozen Battlefront''' is a small town surrounded by mountains on most sides. Any side not covered by a mountain was instead blocked off by a large wall. The town consisted of a few stone buildings and one structure which has a floating neon blue ball on it. Outside the town there is a small forest. Some buildings can be found outside the town's walls, like a giant clock tower.

Enemy path started at the caves and ended at the center of the town.
